correctness.rationale: The four transverse intersection points on C1 are parameterized by u=-1,2,3,6 and form a projective frame; any projectivity preserving {C1,C2} must induce one of 24 permutations. Independently reconstructed each unique 3x3 projective map using SymPy exact rationals, checked both quadratic-form pullbacks, and got 4 preserving the ordered pair, 0 exchanging the pair, 1 preserving C3 in addition. As the source combinatorics distinguishes C3 as the unique conic tangent to both others and there is a single line component, any arrangement equivalence lies in the trivial ordered-triple stabilizer; four distinct displayed lines give four PGL3-orbits and trivial automorphism groups. A finite exhaustive 24-permutation search is a complete proof here because of projective-frame uniqueness, not extrapolation.
